global_rules.narrative_rules:
Shift Coverage:
At an absolute minimum, 3 people must cover the 7 o’clock Contact Team shift from Monday to Friday - if possible, even more. However, this number may vary due to vacations, sick leave, or other absences.

Pikett Duties:
The employee assigned to Pikett is always responsible for the Contact Team shift starting at 07:00 throughout the week, including Saturday.

08:00 Shift Assignment:
The Contact Team shift starting at 08:00 is staffed only after the requirements for the 07:00 and 09:00 Contact Team shifts are fulfilled.

Weekly Shift Assignment:
Each shift is assigned to an employee for an entire week. Employees assigned to the 07:00 Contact Team shift will cover this shift for the whole week. Exceptions to this rule are rare and typically only occur when multiple employees are on leave and urgent coverage is needed. In such cases, employees assigned to the 08:00 shift may also cover the 09:00 shift if necessary.

nobody works on the first of January except the pikett roles

Further Instructions: 
- Kompensation means that the employee doesn't work that day. 
- Ideally just one employee covers Techbar the same week (and not multiple different employees)

IMPORTANT: DO NOT WRITE SHIFTS OR TIME OFF AGAIN IF THERE IS ALREADY AN ENTRY. OTHERWISE, IT WILL APPEAR TWICE IN THE SCHEDULE. THIS MEANS THAT FOR DAYS WHERE A SHIFT IS ALREADY COVERED OR SOMEONE IS NOT WORKING, YOU WRITE NOTHING.
global_rules.output_format_instructions: Return a valid JSON schedule. Top-level keys: dates[], assignments[], violations[], and notes. Each assignment maps (date, role, shift_id) -> employee_id.

Ich schaue noch, ob ich jemanden finde, der Schichten tauscht.
Habe um 13.30 Uhr einen Zahnarztermin und würde gerne anschliessend von 15-17 Uhr kompensieren und mich für den Rest des Nachmittags abmelden. Danke
An der Schichtplannung mit AI dran

Aber ich muss kurz zur Nachkontrolle von letzter Woche und es war sehr schwierig noch vor Weihnachten, einen Termin zu finden.

(Wahrscheinlich, bin ich nicht mal 1h weg und nur 45 Minuten)!
